title: Sound Classifier
text: Classify sounds in audio signal, 1 input, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Overlap percentage (%)} sets the overlap percentage between consecutive mel, {Classification} selects to output sound classification and {Predictions} sets the output all scores and associated labels. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: labels
ports.summary: Class labels for predicted scores vector

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal in Hz 16e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Overlap percentage (%)
params.values: Overlap percentage between consecutive mel spectrograms 50 (default) | [0 100)

params.name: Classification
params.values: Select to output sound classification on (default) | off

params.name: Predictions
params.values: Output all scores and associated labels off (default) | on
